summary: Admin action-level QA on mobile viewport. Tested KYC, Pay Requests, Analytics, Merchants, QR Management, Pool Admin, Deployment Info, BioPay Audit, Taxi Admin, and Restaurant Tables Admin pages. Found and fixed 1 critical bug in MerchantAdminPage.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toLowerCase)' when filtering merchants with undefined name/email fields

issues: React warning: Each child in a list should have a unique 'key' prop - minor issue

action_items: MerchantAdminPage: Fix React key warning for list items (minor)
critical_code_review_comments: MerchantAdminPage had null safety issue - m.name and m.email could be undefined causing crash. Fixed by adding fallback to empty string.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin pages tested on mobile viewport (390x844). All major admin pages load correctly: KYC, Pay Requests, Analytics, Merchants, QR Management, Pool Admin, Deployment Info, BioPay Audit, Taxi Admin, Restaurant Tables Admin.
